Reduced from a live Strix Halo (gfx1151) host observed during Strix Halo
support work. Its KFD topology reports `heap_type 1` on the unified-memory
bank -- the same value the existing discrete-GPU fixtures (discrete-spx,
discrete-large-gtt, multi-xcp) use for dedicated VRAM. The PCI device ID
`0x1586`, `local_mem_size 0`, and `gfx_target_version 110501` (gfx1151) are
captured verbatim from the live node. `local_mem_size` is deliberately not
used for classification because current Linux emits zero for discrete GPU
nodes too. PCI BDF, mem_info byte counts' precision, and the gpu_metrics
payload are synthesized/sanitized (real header: format 3, content 0,
matching kgd_pp_interface.h's v3.0 layout). hwmon exposes only an `edge`
label, matching the live host -- no `junction` channel, so hotspot stays
unsupported_hardware by design.

Guards the exact `0x1586` GTT-accounting override: without it, this device's
real mem_info_gtt_total (~124 GiB) would be reported as a 512 MiB VRAM pool.
